name: openai-chat-playground
description: A TypeScript playground for experimenting with OpenAI chat APIs.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.format: prettier --write --ignore-unknown package.json .gitignore .prettierignore .prettierrc.json .env.example README.md AGENTS.md eslint.config.mjs frontend backend .github
scripts.format:check: prettier --check --ignore-unknown package.json .gitignore .prettierignore .prettierrc.json .env.example README.md AGENTS.md eslint.config.mjs frontend backend .github
